rhs.name: Clematis cirrhosa var. purpurascens 'Freckles' (C)
rhs.note: The record that the RHS synonym page for C. cirrhosa 'Freckles' (223017) points to; its own name-status field was not read.

palette.role: Winter and early-spring flowers on a sheltered, sunny, accessible lower support.

attachment.supportNeeds: Fine support that a leaf stalk can clasp, in a sheltered sunny lower zone.

wood.basis: RHS pruning group 1: flowers on shoots produced in the previous summer.

monthsUK.basis: Months read from the RHS season wording (spring = Mar-May, summer = Jun-Aug, autumn = Sep-Nov, winter = Dec-Feb; early, mid and late are the first, second and third month).

flowering.display: Cream bell-shaped flowers heavily spotted red; silky seedheads later.

site.aspect: Sunny, warm, sheltered south or west exposure; a cooler shaded base helps.

calendar.note: Group 1: light pruning immediately after flowering, and only if needed.

management.notes: Light pruning only, after bloom. Hard pruning while the previous-year shoots carry buds or flowers loses the display.

hazards: Skin irritant; harmful to pets (rabbits) if eaten (RHS).

sources.label: RHS record for the synonym C. cirrhosa 'Freckles'
